description: Decode a 6–7-character FAA manufacturer/model/series code to aircraft specifications — manufacturer, model, aircraft category, aircraft type, engine type, number of engines, number of seats, weight class, cruise speed, and type-certificate data sheet/holder. Use faa_search_aircraft_types first to discover a code by manufacturer or model name.

code.description: Manufacturer/model/series code (e.g. "2072714") — 6–7 uppercase alphanumeric characters, usually 7. Discover codes via faa_search_aircraft_types.

name: faa_get_aircraft_type

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

builderCertification.description: Builder certification (Type Certificated, Not Type Certificated, Light Sport) as code + label.

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

category.description: Aircraft category (Land, Sea, Amphibian) as code + label.

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

cruiseSpeedMph.description: Cruise speed in mph; often blank (permissible field).

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The code is well-formed but does not identify a known aircraft type. `invalid_code`: The input is not a structurally valid code (expected 6–7 uppercase alphanumeric characters). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

numberOfEngines.description: Number of engines; may be blank on the reference record.

numberOfSeats.description: Number of seats; may be blank on the reference record.

weightClass.description: Weight class as the literal FAA string (e.g. "CLASS 1").

weightClassLabel.description: FAA maximum gross takeoff weight range in pounds; omitted when the raw weight class is unknown.

title: faa-aircraft-registry-mcp-server: get aircraft type
